text: Maria (Design): quick scrub on the pool-creation form—noticed a lot of inline errors stacking up and making the page feel noisy. thoughts on error density vs scanability? Alex K: agreed, feels busy. my instinct: inline for single-field errors, but when 3+ errors show, surface a concise top summary + anchors to fields. keeps scanability. :thinking_face: Jia L: accessibility flag — screen readers should announce the summary first if present (aria-live polite/assertive depending on severity). also prefer `aria-describedby` on fields so focus reads context. Samir: can we make the top summary actionable? e.g., "3 issues — jump to first" that focuses the field and opens helper text. reduces cognitive load. Maria (Design): yes on actionable summary. also debating required indicator: asterisk vs explicit "Required" label. asterisk is compact but might be missed at small sizes. Alex K: prefer asterisk visually, but add hidden text for SRs: `required` and keep visible `*` for visual users. also ensure contrast of the asterisk meets AA. Jia L: +1. if we use `*`, it must be included in the accessible name (label text) so screen readers read "Email, required". avoid relying on color alone. designbot: snippet suggestion: `label: "Email *"; (required)` — and `role=alert` on top summary for immediate announcement when form submitted. Samir: quick copy question for destructive actions inside form (e.g., "remove linked model"): typed-confirm vs simple modal + undo? which pattern pairs better with this reduced-error density direction? Maria (Design): typed-confirm is heavy; for small destructive actions within a list I prefer a modal with clear danger copy + undo toast. typed-confirm for irreversible platform-level deletes (models, tenants). Alex K: agree. keep typed-confirm for high blast-radius only. also ensure modals trap focus and the primary button text is explicit: "Delete model forever" not just "Delete". Jia L: accessibility nit: ensure modals have `aria-describedby` with the destructive consequences and that undo toasts are keyboard dismissible. Maria (Design): actionable summary copy proposal: "3 errors — fix the highlighted fields to continue" and CTA "Jump to first". anyone prefer different tone? Samir: short + utilitarian is good. maybe "3 form errors — jump to first" to reduce reading time. Alex K: small visual tweak: collapse helper text by default and expand on focus to reduce vertical clutter. keeps inline help but less density. Jia L: that's good; ensure expansion is programmatic (not just CSS hover) so keyboard users can access it. Maria (Design): cool — I'll mock up two variants (top-summary + anchors vs inline-with-collapsible-helpers) and include the `sr-only` required text, aria-live summary, and modal copy rules. will drop screenshots in this thread. :sparkles: Samir: thanks — ping when ready for dev review. Alex K: +1, thanks Maria. Maria (Design): tagging deliverables: mockups, copy snippets, accessibility checklist. ETA tomorrow EOD.
